open_points.subject: A6 INV-20 Required tests
open_points.text: a damaged mark without a placement stops a new placement (`test_a_damaged_mark_without_a_placement_stops_a_new_placement`)
open_points.question: What exactly must this check assert: the returned refusal and code, absence of a PhotoPlacement record, absence of a stored image, preservation of the damaged mark, or all of these?
options: Assert only that no PhotoPlacement record is created.
Assert an M08 refusal with STATE_UNAVAILABLE and that no placement record is created.
Assert an M08 refusal with STATE_UNAVAILABLE, the damaged mark unchanged, and no placement record or stored image created.
open_points.default_guess: Assert M08 with STATE_UNAVAILABLE, preserve the damaged mark, and create neither a placement record nor a stored image.

open_points.subject: A10 files_artifacts security review
open_points.text: - files_artifacts: APPLICABLE; references: A1, A2, A5, A6, A8; affected: M01, M02, M03, M04, connections file, source folders, Portal binary store
open_points.question: Does the reference to A6 make the durable M07 publication-mark record and its state folder part of this category despite their omission from the affected list, or is that list exhaustive?
options: The A6 reference includes placement and publication-mark state records even though they are not named under affected.
The affected list is exhaustive, so M07 and its mark record are outside this security review.
Add M07, placement and mark records, and the state folder explicitly to the affected list.
open_points.default_guess: Add M07, the placement and publication-mark records, and the state folder explicitly to the affected list.

witness.initial: A project has no placement record and has a damaged publication-mark record in the state folder.
events: A security reviewer evaluates the files_artifacts category after the changed INV-20 scenario is added.
outcomes: The reviewer follows the A6 reference and reviews the damaged mark record as an affected artifact.
The reviewer treats the affected list as exhaustive and does not review the damaged mark record.
witness.observer: The security reviewer and the State 3 gate
